description_en: Queries the sending records and sending status of card SMS messages for a single phone number
description_zh: 查询单个号码的卡片短信发送记录和发送状态等信息
name: GetCardSmsDetails

parameters.help_en: The current page number when viewing sending records with pagination
parameters.help_zh: 分页查看发送记录，指定发送记录的当前页码
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The number of card SMS records to display per page when viewing sending records with pagination.

Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh:
分页查看发送记录，指定每页显示的卡片短信记录数量。

取值范围为1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The date when the card SMS message was sent. You can query records from the last 30 days.

Format: yyyyMMdd. Example: 20240112
parameters.help_zh:
卡片短信发送日期，支持查询最近30天的记录。

格式为yyyyMMdd，例如20240112
parameters.name: send_date

parameters.help_en: The domestic phone number that received the SMS message. Format: an 11-digit phone number, such as 1390000****
parameters.help_zh: 接收短信的国内手机号码。格式：11位手机号码，例如1390000****
parameters.name: phone_number

parameters.help_en: The card SMS sending ID. Obtain the value of the BizCardId field from the response when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434120.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434119.html operation to send card SMS messages
parameters.help_zh: 卡片短信发送ID。通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434120.html接口或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434119.html接口发送卡片短信时，获取返回值中的BizCardId字段
parameters.name: biz_card_id

parameters.help_en: The text SMS sending ID. Obtain the value of the BizSmsId field from the response when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434120.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434119.html operation to send card SMS messages
parameters.help_zh: 文本短信发送ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434120.html接口或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434119.html接口发送卡片短信时，获取返回值中的BizSmsId字段
parameters.name: biz_sms_id

parameters.help_en: The digital SMS sending ID. Obtain the value of the BizDigitalId field from the response when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434120.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434119.html operation to send card SMS messages
parameters.help_zh: 数字短信发送ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434120.html接口或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434119.html接口发送卡片短信时，获取返回值中的BizDigitalId字段
parameters.name: biz_digit_id
